name: Quadratic Blowup
essence: Every guest scans the accumulated roster, producing six comparisons for four distinct names.

examples.summary: Every guest scans the accumulated roster, producing six comparisons for four distinct names.
examples.mechanism: The nested loops repeatedly traverse a growing array and the function imposes no input-size limit, giving quadratic work for distinct names.
examples.expected_behavior: Use bounded input or an indexed membership check so work scales linearly with the number of guests.

ingredients.suggests: Each outer-loop iteration grows the collection traversed by the inner loop.
The function accepts an arbitrary list and scans every supplied name with no length limit.
